title: Freezing smarter: The trends shaping spiral freezing innovation
summary: As food processors look for more capacity, efficiency, and reliability from every square meter of production space, freezer design is evolving too. Torbjörn Persson, Freezer Global Product Line Senior Manager JBT Marel, shares what customers are asking for and how JBT Marel is innovating to meet those demands.
body_markdown:
##### Getting more capacity into existing spaces


Another trend influencing freezer design is the need to increase capacity without increasing the size of the facility. For many processors, simply building a bigger facility is not a realistic answer to growing production demands.


“Constructing new facilities is very costly, so a large proportion of the freezers we sell are intended for existing facilities,” Persson explains.


That puts a premium on compact equipment. Spiral freezing naturally offers an advantage by carrying products vertically through the freezer rather than requiring a long linear footprint. The design of the Frigoscandia GYRoCOMPACT takes this further through its self-stacking belt.
